Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.grid

package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.grid
A PovGrid view over a data slice response, plus a plain-text printer for it. Despite living under impl, DataSliceGrid is the actual return type of PbcsPlanType's retrieve methods, so callers interact with it directly.

    A PovGrid view over a DataSlice, exposing its POV, top axis, left axis, and data cells as a two-dimensional grid.

    A single cell of a DataSliceGrid, which may be a member header, a data value, or blank.

    A DataSliceGrid.Cell that represents a member on one of the grid's axes.

    Prints a DataSliceGrid to the console for debugging purposes.
